title: Reduce STIM workflow friction
body: Collect consent in one compact review, preserve explicit model/provider approval, and allow bounded same-day finite schedules with spacing and quiet-hour enforcement.

log.text: Mapped STIM contract, README, and messaging skill tests. Implementing one-shot consent review plus bounded same-day cadence.
Updated consent collection and bounded same-day scheduling contract; targeted tests pass.
Implemented one-shot consent review and up to five sends per rolling 24 hours with 60-minute spacing. All 65 skill tests pass.
